name: Mahi

source.name: Near Bhopawar village, Sardarpur tehsil, Vindhya Range

significance: silt deposition at Gulf of Khambhat
did_you_know: The Mahi is one of the few Indian rivers that crosses the Tropic of Cancer twice, first flowing north out of Madhya Pradesh and then looping back south through Rajasthan into Gujarat.
Silt carried down by the Mahi has steadily shallowed the Gulf of Khambhat over centuries, contributing to the decline of the once-prosperous port of Khambhat.
The river gives its name to Gujarat's Mahisagar district, and is popularly called 'Mahisagar' for its considerable width in its lower course.
